title: profiles.language
description: Payload for the profiles.language comm Function — ask the owner of the fact, at the moment it is needed, which language a user reads in. Returns {"app_language": str|null, "auto_detected_language": str|null}: the language the user CHOSE (null when they never chose one) and the last language observed from their Accept-Language header (null when none was ever observed). A user with no profile row answers null/null — missing is not invented. Replaces the mirror shape, where a sibling kept a copy of this fact and could not tell "no preference" from "the copy never arrived"; a caller that cannot reach this function gets FunctionNotRegistered/FunctionCallError and knows it is guessing.
